slots.notes: Center-column square showcase video (object-cover, autoplay/muted/inline, no controls, no border-radius); fills a 220->460px equal width/height box
Display face for the 'submissions' H2 (.font-firs); native family 'TT Firs Neue' with Inter/system-ui fallback
Body/UI face for eyebrow label and all card title/subtitle text; native family 'Inter' with system-ui/-apple-system fallback

mechanic: A full-viewport vertically-centered three-column layout (left/right chamfered nomination cards flanking a center square autoplay video under a 'submissions' heading) with only a per-card hover-lift and a bottom transparent-to-surface gradient fade.
techDelivery: plain React + Tailwind CSS (no extra UI libraries), with a small global CSS block declaring the body font and the .font-firs display-font class
reskinNotes: Card 'border' is an inline SVG polygon whose stroke hex rgba(6,99,119,0.25) is baked into markup (not a CSS token), so border recolor requires editing the SVG; subtitle 'muted' tone is fg at opacity-80 rather than a distinct fgMuted color; all eyebrow/heading/6x card title+subtitle copy and the video source URL are hardcoded in JSX; #F0F5F7 surface is duplicated as the fade gradient's rgba(240,245,247,*) stops.
